HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.

2. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   C. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)

   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets

7. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.

   C. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.

   A. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   D. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   D. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

13. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   B. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.

16. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
